findings.description: I-1: Cut out and patch damaged paving wearing surface, address heavy alligatoring, re-stripe lot
I-2: Clear silt/debris near storm water basin, install rip-rap, secure precast wheelstops at paving edge
I-3: Significant landscaping clean-up: trim trees near northwest overhead wires, clear perimeter vegetation from fence, trim/remove pines on north side, replace dead ornamental trees
I-4: Repair perimeter chain link fence (top rails, fabric) once vegetation cleared; sections only
I-5: Repair and re-secure north wall deck and ledger; possible ledger replacement and additional thru-bolts
I-6: Exterior masonry: new control joint and window sealants, re-point sealed cracks, examine/repair north wall thin-set brick and seal cavity
I-7: Examine/clear north side roof leaders incl. below-grade boots; re-attach disconnected leader
I-8: Replace roof membrane within one to two years with unballasted single-ply (e.g. TPO) with tapered insulation; includes smoke vents if required; $7.00/SF
